req.title: Honour Accept: application/json
req.statement: The system shall respect an Accept: application/json request header by serialising responses as JSON.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that when a client sends Accept: application/json, the server must respond with JSON-serialised content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — standard GET /get with Accept: application/json yields 200 and valid JSON with correct Content-Type; (2) positive EP — POST /post with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (3) positive EP — GET /headers with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON containing the Accept header; (4) negative NEG — GET /get without Accept header still returns JSON (httpbin always returns JSON, so absence of header is a valid negative-path check); (5) boundary BVA — Accept header with multiple media types including application/json (e.g. text/html,application/json) still yields JSON; (6) DT — PUT /put and DELETE /delete with Accept: application/json both yield 200 JSON; (7) boundary BVA — /cookies with Accept: application/json yields JSON with 'cookies' key; (8) positive EP — /basic-auth with correct credentials and Accept: application/json yields JSON with authenticated=True. All assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /get with Accept: application/json header
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send POST /post with Accept: application/json and form data
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'},
        data={'key': 'value'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body
    assert body['form'] == {'key': 'value'}

test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_body()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with Accept: application/json and correct Basic auth
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert body['authenticated'] == True
    assert body['user'] == 'user'

test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true()

tests.name: test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_parseable_not_empty
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: args dict in JSON body contains exactly {'foo': 'bar'}
trace: BVA: query param boundary — single param reflected exactly in args
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_parseable_not_empty():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get(
        '/get?foo=bar',
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert body['json'] is None

test_get_with_accept_json_response_body_is_parseable_not_empty()
